limitations: Single-reviewer dossier; not eligible for data/vulnerabilities.jsonl yet.
Location was established by static reading; no proof-of-concept was executed against 12.0.3.
The exact stack depth at which the runtime aborts depends on platform, thread stack size and call path; this dossier does not claim a constant.
The advisory-referenced fix commit sets 128, while the shipped 13.0.1 default is 64 because of a follow-up commit; both are recorded to avoid attributing the wrong content to the fix commit.

critical_operation.description: The vulnerable default lives in this region. The protected constructor (324-332) leaves _maxDepth null, and the depth guard in Push (353-357) only throws when _maxDepth != null. With no cap, deeply nested JSON drives unbounded reader/serializer recursion until the process hits StackOverflowException. The fix adds a default max depth in the constructor and in JsonSerializerSettings; 13.0.1 ships 64.

entry_point.description: Public deserialization entry points pass attacker-controlled JSON into JsonSerializer/JsonTextReader with default settings.

trace.description: depth guard skipped entirely when _maxDepth is null

source_crosscheck.notes: All three families agree on <13.0.1 and CWE-755. CNA publishes no CVSS metric; NVD and the CISA-ADP secondary metric agree on 7.5 with the same vector, and OSV records the same vector. The advisory-referenced fix commit introduced the cap as 128; a later commit b6dc05be lowered the default to 64 before tag 13.0.1, so the fixed-release content is 64 rather than 128. 独立复核指出 CNA/NVD 把栈溢出的触发点描述为反序列化，而源码显示 reader 使用显式栈、序列化深 JToken 时才递归溢出；两种描述都指向同一个“无深度上限”的根因，但触发阶段以源码为准记录。

fix_commits.message: Change JsonReader and JsonSerializer default max depth to 128 (#2462)
